lead: Ampbio is an authorised distributor in India for Jena Bioscience, Germany. This range opens with the products Jena features: non-hydrolysable and click-chemistry nucleotides, a dNTP bundle and Quantifoil® cryo-EM grids.

products.name: ATPγS

rows: Adenosine-5'-(γ-thio)-triphosphate, Tetralithium salt; Adenosine-5'-(3-thio)-triphosphate, Adenosine-5'-(3-thiotriphosphate); Ado-5'-PPP[S]
Λ max 259 nm, ε 15.4 L mmol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ (Tris-HCl pH 7.5)

For reasons of stability, please make sure that the pH value of a solution of this product never drops below 7.0. This can be achieved by dissolving the nucleotide in a buffer of your choice (50 - 100 mM, pH 7 - 10). Dissolve and adjust concentration photometrically.

products.summary: ATPγS (adenosine-5'-(γ-thio)-triphosphate, tetralithium salt) is a nucleoside phosphate stabilised against hydrolytic degradation, so it can bind nucleoside receptors directly. Applications include the modulation of intracellular signalling, purinergic receptor signalling, regulation of cation channels, kinase substrate studies and 5'-end labelling of DNA and RNA with T4 polynucleotide kinase.
applications: 5'-end labelling with T4 Polynucleotide Kinase (T4 PNK) of DNA and RNA
Agonistic ligand, mainly for nucleoside receptor A1
ligands: Agonist for P2Y2 and P2Y12 receptors and for the P2X(2) purinoreceptor

products.name: GpCpp (GMPCPP)

rows: Λ max 252 nm, ε 13.7 L mmol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ (Tris-HCl pH 7.5)
Store at -20 °C; Short term exposure (up to 1 week cumulative) to ambient temperature possible.

products.summary: GpCpp (GMPCPP; guanosine-5'-[(α,β)-methyleno]triphosphate, sodium salt) is a non-hydrolysable GTP analogue, supplied as a 10 mM solution in water. Applications include microtubule assembly and the dynamics of microtubule bundles, cryomicroscopy and atomic force microscopy.

products.name: 5-Ethynyl-uridine (5-EU)

rows: Up to 200 mM in 1 x PBS or water by heating the obtained suspension for 1 minute by 70 °C, less soluble in DMSO
Λ max 286 nm, ε 12.0 L mmol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ (Tris-HCl pH 7.5)
Store at -20 °C; store dry and under inert gas; Short term exposure (up to 1 week cumulative) to ambient temperature possible.

products.summary: Ethynyl-labeled uridine (5-EU) can be used as a replacement for BrU (5-Bromo-uridine) to measure de novo RNA synthesis in proliferating cells. 5-EU is cell permeable and incorporates into nascent RNA instead of its natural analog uridine. The resulting ethynyl-functionalized RNA can subsequently be detected via Cu(I)-catalyzed click chemistry that offers the choice to introduce a Biotin group (via Azides of Biotin) for subsequent purification tasks or a fluorescent group (via Azides of fluorescent dyes) for subsequent microscopic imaging.

products.name: 5-Ethynyl-dUTP (5-EdUTP)

rows: Λ max 288 nm, ε 12.0 L mmol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ (Tris-HCl pH 7.5)
Store at -20 °C; Short term exposure (up to 1 week cumulative) to ambient temperature possible.

products.summary: 5-EdUTP (5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine 5'-triphosphate, sodium salt) is incorporated into DNA by PCR with family B polymerases and by primer extension with family A Taq or family B polymerases. The resulting ethynyl-functionalised DNA can then be processed by Cu(I)-catalysed click chemistry: to introduce a biotin group for purification, a fluorescent group for microscopic imaging, or to crosslink the DNA to azide-functionalised biomolecules such as proteins.
applications: Incorporation into DNA by PCR with family B polymerases (Pwo, Deep Vent exo– or KOD XL)
Incorporation into DNA by primer extension with family A polymerase Taq and family B polymerases (Pwo, Deep Vent exo– or KOD XL)
Click-chemistry labelling of the DNA with biotin (via biotin azides) or fluorescent dyes (via dye azides), or crosslinking to azide-functionalised biomolecules

products.name: Quantifoil® R 1.2/1.3 on 300 Copper Mesh
products.summary: Quantifoil® R 1.2/1.3 carbon film with circular holes of 1.2 µm diameter and an interspace of 1.3 µm in both dimensions, applied on 300 copper mesh. Suitable for magnifications around 50,000× and higher; a support film for biological samples in cryo-EM.
applications: Support film for biological samples in cryo-EM techniques

products.name: 5-Ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine (5-EdU)

rows: DMSO, up to 200 mM (at room temperature) in 1 x PBS or water by heating the obtained suspension for 1 minute by 70 °C
Λ max 288 nm, ε 12.0 L mmol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ (Tris-HCl pH 7.5)
Store at -20 °C; store dry and under inert gas; Short term exposure (up to 1 week cumulative) to ambient temperature possible.

products.summary: 5-EdU (5-Ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine) can be used as a replacement for BrdU (5-Bromo-2'-deoxyuridine) to measure de novo DNA synthesis during the S-phase of the cell cycle. 5-EdU is cell permeable and incorporates into replicating DNA instead of its natural analog thymidine. The resulting ethynyl-functionalized DNA can subsequently be detected via Cu(I)-catalyzed click chemistry that offers the choice to introduce a Biotin group (via Azides of Biotin) for subsequent purification tasks or a fluorescent group (via Azides of fluorescent dyes) for subsequent microscopic imaging.

products.summary: GppNHp (GMPPNP; guanosine-5'-[(β,γ)-imido]triphosphate, tetralithium salt) is a non-hydrolysable GTP analogue. Applications include X-ray structures of elongation factor EF-G and of Rab27, the conformational switch of IF(α,β,γ) and the dynamics of ribosomes.
applications: X-ray structure of elongation factor EF-G
ligands: Initiation factors IF2 and IF(α,β,γ), and elongation factor EF-G
